integrity: All stated parameter formulas have a complete self-contained proof; finite verification is supplementary and must not be interpreted as exhaustive across infinite parameters.
scientific_limitations: Only UT4 over finite characteristic-two fields, not all p or all n.
All arities of square-one group elements, not unrestricted commuting tuples.
Maximal elementary abelian subgroups are counted as distinct subsets, not up to conjugacy.
Historical novelty comparison is substantial but incomplete; independent audit unperformed.
title: All-arity commuting-involution counts and maximal elementary abelian subgroups of \(UT_4(\mathbb F_{2^f})\)
